# Note: This is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Only competition. 

Welcome to Malaysia FMC Championship 2025! As FMC is not being held at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2025), this is your chance to become the Malaysia's Fewest Moves Champion! The competition will be held in Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru and Penang. Please check select the [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025#66171-location) you wish to join FMC when you make the payment. 

**3x3x3 Fewest Moves event** (**this may not be recommended for new competitor**). 

For those who are interested in joining **Please Be Quiet Kuala Lumpur 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKualaLumpur2025) /  **Please Be Quiet Johor 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietJohor2025). The event will take place at the same venue before this competition.

#### After the completion of your registration, please send us an email regarding which location that you wish to join, so we can estimate the turnout for each location.

[![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025)

items.information:
## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2025!
​
[![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg)](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship)
​
Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.


**Please note**
Competitors of all nationalities are welcome,

There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition

Participants representing Malaysia will have the opportunity to win special trophies, prizes, and the title of Malaysia Champion. The number of competitors in all final rounds may increase until there are at least 6 Malaysian competitors who advance

**If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Information & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2025#63823-information-announcements) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.**

Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
•
***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.name: Malaysian Cube Championship 2017
items.information:
Malaysian Cube Championship 2017 is opened to all nationalities, but only Malaysians are eligible to win the prizes.


**Registration info**
* Registration opens on Tuesday, 7th November, 8pm (GMT+8).
* The steps for registration are as follows:
1. [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysianCubeChampionship2017/register) 
2. [Pay](https://www.mycubeassociation.com/payment-malaysiancubechamp) according the the events you registered.
3. Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration.

**In order to complete your registration please proceed with the payment according to the events registered. Payment which does not match with the event registered will not be accepted and the payment will be refund.
